title.zh: 【以太坊基金会和 OA 推出 zkAPI，支持匿名 AI API 支付】
title.en: 【以太坊基金会和 OA 推出 zkAPI，支持匿名 AI API 支付】

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation and the Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge payment system that decouples payment from identity so users can pay for AI API inference (and other metered services) anonymously through time-limited, quota-capped API keys settled against on-chain vault deposits.
current_state.en: The Ethereum Foundation and the Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge payment system that decouples payment from identity so users can pay for AI API inference (and other metered services) anonymously through time-limited, quota-capped API keys settled against on-chain vault deposits.
